site.tagline: Compassionate, modern care for every member of the family.
site.description: Willowbrook Veterinary Clinic offers preventive care, surgery, dental, diagnostics, and emergency services for dogs, cats, and small pets — with online booking and a member portal.

about.title: Built around compassion, backed by modern medicine
about.intro: {siteName} opened with a simple goal: give every pet the kind of unhurried, thorough care we'd want for our own animals — and give owners a modern way to stay on top of it.
about.facilityBody: Our clinic was designed around reducing stress for anxious patients — from separate waiting areas for dogs and cats to quiet exam rooms and equipment that keeps most diagnostics in-house, so your pet isn't waiting days for answers.

dogCatAreas.title: Separate dog & cat waiting areas
dogCatAreas.detail: Lower-stress visits for every patient, with species-specific exam rooms.

labImaging.title: In-house lab & imaging
labImaging.detail: Digital X-ray, ultrasound, and same-hour bloodwork on site.

anaesthesia.title: Modern anaesthesia monitoring
anaesthesia.detail: Continuous monitoring for every sedated or surgical procedure.

fearFree.title: Fear-free handling techniques
fearFree.detail: Staff trained in low-stress handling for anxious or reactive pets.

about.teamBody: A small, experienced team that knows your pets by name — not just by chart number.

surgery.name: Surgery & Procedures
surgery.summary: From routine spays to complex soft-tissue surgery.
surgery.description: Our surgical suite is equipped for everything from routine sterilizations to complex soft-tissue and emergency procedures, with full pre-anaesthetic screening and dedicated post-op monitoring for every patient.

spay-neuter.name: Spay / Neuter
spay-neuter.description: Routine sterilization with pre-anaesthetic bloodwork and take-home pain plan.

soft-tissue-surgery.name: Soft-Tissue Surgery
soft-tissue-surgery.description: Mass removals, wound repair, and abdominal procedures.

post-op-care-plan.name: Post-Op Care Plan
post-op-care-plan.description: Suture check, pain management review, and recovery monitoring.

preventive-care.name: Primary & Preventive Care
preventive-care.summary: Vaccinations, wellness exams, and puppy & kitten checks.
preventive-care.description: The foundation of a long, healthy life — core and lifestyle vaccinations, wellness exams, parasite prevention, microchipping, and health certificates for travel or breed registration.

wellness-exam.name: Wellness Exam
wellness-exam.description: Full nose-to-tail check-up with a licensed veterinarian.

vaccination-package.name: Vaccination Package
vaccination-package.description: Core + lifestyle vaccines tailored to age and risk.

puppy-kitten-starter-visit.name: Puppy & Kitten Starter Visit
puppy-kitten-starter-visit.description: First-visit exam, deworming, and vaccine schedule planning.

microchipping-id.name: Microchipping & ID
microchipping-id.description: Permanent ID chip with registry enrollment.

dental.name: Dental Services
dental.summary: Tartar removal, dental X-rays, and extractions.
dental.description: Dental disease affects most pets by age three. We offer ultrasonic scaling and polishing, full-mouth dental radiographs, and extractions under monitored anaesthesia.

dental-cleaning-polish.name: Dental Cleaning & Polish
dental-cleaning-polish.description: Ultrasonic scaling and polishing under anaesthesia.

dental-x-rays.name: Dental X-Rays
dental-x-rays.description: Full-mouth radiographs to catch disease below the gumline.

tooth-extraction.name: Tooth Extraction
tooth-extraction.description: Simple to surgical extractions with pain management.

diagnostics.name: Laboratory & Diagnostics
diagnostics.summary: In-house bloodwork, urinalysis, and rapid test panels.
diagnostics.description: Our in-house lab returns most bloodwork and urinalysis results within the hour, so treatment decisions don't wait on a courier.

bloodwork-panel.name: Bloodwork Panel
bloodwork-panel.description: Complete blood count and chemistry panel, in-house results.

urinalysis.name: Urinalysis
urinalysis.description: Screening for kidney, bladder, and metabolic issues.

rapid-test-panels.name: Rapid Test Panels
rapid-test-panels.description: Parvo, heartworm, tick-borne disease, and FeLV/FIV screening.

imaging.name: Imaging
imaging.summary: Digital radiography and ultrasound on site.
imaging.description: Digital X-ray and ultrasound equipment on site means faster, clearer answers for injuries, swallowed objects, and internal medicine cases — no referral wait.

digital-radiography.name: Digital Radiography
digital-radiography.description: High-resolution X-ray imaging with same-day read.

abdominal-ultrasound.name: Abdominal Ultrasound
abdominal-ultrasound.description: Non-invasive imaging for organs and soft tissue.

orthopedics.name: Orthopedics
orthopedics.summary: ACL injuries, fracture repair, and spinal care.
orthopedics.description: From cranial cruciate ligament injuries to fracture stabilization and spinal cases, our orthopedic service pairs surgical expertise with a structured rehab plan.

orthopedic-consultation.name: Orthopedic Consultation
orthopedic-consultation.description: Lameness exam with imaging referral plan.

cruciate-acl-repair.name: Cruciate (ACL) Repair
cruciate-acl-repair.description: Surgical stabilization for cranial cruciate ligament injuries.

endoscopy.name: Endoscopy
endoscopy.summary: Minimally invasive scoping for scopes & swallowed objects.
endoscopy.description: Bronchoscopy and gastroscopy let us investigate chronic coughing, swallowing difficulty, or a suspected foreign body without open surgery in many cases.

gastroscopy.name: Gastroscopy
gastroscopy.description: Camera-guided exam of the oesophagus and stomach.

bronchoscopy.name: Bronchoscopy
bronchoscopy.description: Airway scoping for chronic cough or breathing issues.

foreign-body-retrieval.name: Foreign Body Retrieval
foreign-body-retrieval.description: Non-surgical removal of swallowed objects where possible.

emergency.name: Emergency Care
emergency.description: Accidents don't wait for an appointment. We prioritize acute cases for same-day stabilization and treatment, with an after-hours line for existing clients.

after-hours-consultation.name: After-Hours Consultation
after-hours-consultation.description: Phone triage line for existing clients.

essential.name: Essential
essential.tagline: For healthy pets that just need the basics covered.

wellness.name: Wellness Plus
wellness.tagline: Our most popular plan for ongoing preventive care.

complete.name: Complete Care
complete.tagline: Comprehensive coverage for senior pets or multi-pet households.
